subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale branch be rebased and consolidated into current main's sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or should current main's existing guidance remain the product direction?
rationale: Current main already has overlapping delegation guidance and supports configured nested spawning, while this PR adds duplicate prompt policy and contradicts the depth-aware runtime contract.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and all model-facing prompt surfaces together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat current main guidance as sufficient and close this stale branch without adding another prompt-policy source.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this PR and made the related direction call that this branch was meant to replace.
